memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Patient presents with newly diagnosed non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and stage 1 hypertension.
He reports occasional fatigue after work, no abdominal pain. BMI 24, blood pressure 138/86 mmHg, liver edge palpable 2 cm below costal margin. Lungs clear, heart regular.

losartan 50 mg OD

memories.text: 12-lead ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST-T changes, left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No evidence of ischemia or hypertrophy.
